_comment: REAL deal, analysed at announcement (18 Jan 2022). Every fact is taken from the documents in _documents, with section, page and snippet in _sources. Money and shares in millions; percentages as decimals. Pages are 'PDF page / printed page' of the saved copies.

_documents.10K: Activision Blizzard, Inc. Form 10-K for the year ended 31 Dec 2021 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/718877/000162828022003992/atvi-20211231.htm
_documents.DEFM14A: Activision Blizzard, Inc. definitive merger proxy statement (DEFM14A), incl. Annex A Merger Agreement — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/718877/000110465922036155/tm225196-4_defm14a.htm
_documents.MSFT_PR: Microsoft press release, 18 Jan 2022, 'Microsoft to acquire Activision Blizzard to bring the joy and community of gaming to everyone, across every device' — https://news.microsoft.com/source/2022/01/18/microsoft-to-acquire-activision-blizzard-to-bring-the-joy-and-community-of-gaming-to-everyone-across-every-device/
_documents.INVESTING: Investing.com, Activision Blizzard historical data (daily 'Price' = regular close), accessed 28 Sep 2026 — https://www.investing.com/equities/activision-inc-historical-data — screenshot: data/sources/atvi_close_2022-01-14.png

share_build.as_of: 13 Jan 2022 (Merger Agreement Capitalization Date); option strike at 31 Dec 2021

offer_price_per_share.snippet: you will be entitled to receive $95.00 in cash, without interest, for each share of our common stock

unaffected_share_price.section: Activision Blizzard Stock Price History, row 'Jan 14, 2022', column 'Price'
unaffected_share_price.note: The DEFM14A does not state the close in dollars. Cross-check: it states a premium of 'approximately 45.3% to Activision Blizzard's closing stock price on January 14, 2022, the last trading day prior to the announcement of the merger' (Q&A, PDF p.27 / p.16); 95 / 65.39 - 1 = 45.28%.

ebitda.section: Consolidated Statements of Operations (operating income) + Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (D&A)
ebitda.page: PDF p.72 / F-4 and PDF p.74 / F-6
ebitda.note: CALCULATED, not reported: EBITDA = operating income 3,259 + D&A 116 = 3,375 (verified in tests/test_activision.py). ASSUMPTION: 'Amortization of capitalized software development costs and intellectual property licenses' (324, cash flow statement) is NOT added back, as it is a recurring game-development cost. Not comparable with the adjusted EBITDA used by Allen & Company in the proxy, which also excludes share-based compensation and one-off items.

total_debt.section: Note 13 Debt — Unsecured Senior Notes table
total_debt.snippet: Total gross long-term debt $ 3,650 | Unamortized discount and deferred financing costs (42) | Total net carrying amount $ 3,608
total_debt.note: Gross principal used (the amount repayable), not the 3,608 carrying value. Revolver undrawn: 'To date, we have not drawn on the Revolver.' Leases excluded (see README limitations).

cash.note: Cash and cash equivalents only. Short-term investments of 195 (MD&A 'Sources of Liquidity', PDF p.56 / p.55) and restricted cash are excluded.

share_build.basic_shares.section: Annex A Merger Agreement, Section 3.7(a) Company Capitalization
share_build.basic_shares.snippet: (A) 779,057,360 shares of Company Common Stock were issued and outstanding (for the avoidance of doubt, excluding shares held in treasury)

share_build.option_tranches[0].number.section: Annex A Merger Agreement, Section 3.7(c) Stock Reservation
share_build.option_tranches[0].number.snippet: (iii) outstanding Company Options to acquire 9,083,202 shares of Company Common Stock

share_build.option_tranches[0].strike.section: Note 16 Share-Based Payments — Stock Option Activity table
share_build.option_tranches[0].strike.note: LIMITATION: the 10-K gives no table by exercise-price range, so all options are one tranche at the weighted-average strike. Strike is at 31 Dec 2021, count at 13 Jan 2022.

share_build.rsus.section: Annex A Merger Agreement, Section 3.7(c) Stock Reservation
share_build.rsus.snippet: (i) time-vesting Company Stock-Based Awards representing the right to receive up to 8,717,050 shares ... (ii) performance-vesting Company Stock-Based Awards representing the right to receive up to 4,424,740 shares ..., assuming achievement of applicable performance goals at target level
share_build.rsus.note: rsus = 8.717050 time-vesting RSUs + 4.424740 PSUs at target (verified in tests/test_activision.py). PSUs at target is an agreed methodology choice (5.180833 at maximum).

stated_equity_value.note: Deliberately left empty: the $68.7bn headline is net of Activision's net cash, i.e. effectively an enterprise value, not an equity value. See _cross_checks.

cost_synergies.note: ASSUMPTION: set to zero. Neither Microsoft nor the proxy disclosed a synergy figure, so synergy metrics equal standalone metrics.

financing_cash.section: Press release para. 2; proxy 'Financing of the Merger'
financing_cash.page: MSFT_PR p.1; DEFM14A PDF p.78 / p.67
financing_cash.snippet: an all-cash transaction | Microsoft has represented to Activision Blizzard that it has available, and will have available at the effective time, the funds necessary to pay the aggregate merger consideration
financing_cash.note: 100% cash consideration; no new debt or stock disclosed in these documents.

tax_rate.note: Not provided: with zero synergies an after-tax synergy figure adds nothing.

headline_transaction_value.snippet: Microsoft will acquire Activision Blizzard for $95.00 per share, in an all-cash transaction valued at $68.7 billion, inclusive of Activision Blizzard's net cash.
headline_transaction_value.note: Net of the target's net cash, so it is compared with our calculated enterprise value, not equity value. Checked in tests/test_activision.py.

proxy_premium.snippet: The per share merger consideration represents a premium of approximately 45.3% to Activision Blizzard's closing stock price on January 14, 2022
